en.hubeali:
From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Zayd Al Zarrad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The great affliction is matched with great Recompense. So when Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Loves a servant, Afflicts him with the great affliction. So the one who is pleased, for him would be the Pleasure in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the one who is angered by the affliction, for him would be the Anger in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 8. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Zayd al-Zarrad from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘

The great misfortunes are matched with great rewards. When Allah loves a servant He tries him with great misfortunes. Whoever accepts it, Allah accepts him and whoever becomes angry with misfortunes, with Allah for him there is anger.”’
